reviews.x: I'm so happy I bought this eyeliner set. The colors are extremely vivid, and they pop, even on my darker skin. I'm a black eyeliner fanatic, and have been wanting to switch things up. I love the mix of colors, which includes average, everyday colors as well as colors appropriate for a night out. They aren't clumpy or runny, and they stay put nicely.  The formula was a pleasant surprise. These pencils glide smoothly, even over eyeshadow and my waterline. The waterline is always a challenging area

I was so excited to receive these eye liners.  All colors came nicely packaged.  It is difficult to remove the shrink wrap on each pencil but I learned to get it started using the lines of perforation in the wrap on one end and pulling down and around each pencil slowly.  I love the sparkly eye liners and the copper and silver ones are gorgeous.  The white one is very soft and the end broke when I was swatching on my arm.  I used a normal makeup sharpener.  It's not a wooden type pencil but more

reviews.t: Yay!  So glad I took a chance and bought these.
reviews.x: Very easy to apply and smudge, if you want a smokey look.  Colors are as described.  Pencil is soft and doesn't pull when applying.  Very happy with these!  I will update if i notice they don't hold up, but so far, so good!  Update:  These are awesome!  They hold up just as well as the $$$ ones.  I'm wearing AQUATIC and the color is bright and really cool.  They don't melt down your face.  I highly recommend these.

reviews.t: So glad I took a chance
reviews.x: These are creamy and dense.  No need to force or press or use a lighter.  See my photo.  I was concerned that if they were as creamy as the other reviewers said that they would not dry.  I made a line of each color on my hand and then went back tried to wipe off with my finger.  Didn't come off.  I am thrilled!

reviews.t: Longest lasting eye product ever tried for the best price!
reviews.x: Before buying products, I read reviews and find the best dupes (best quality copy). My favorite influencer online mentioned Marc Jacobs gel liner as her favorite.  However, Marc Jacobs cost over twenty dollars per gel liner.  I went to another site and the Influencer on Utube compared Marc Jacobs with this L.A. Girl product and gave it a thumbs up. I ordered the pack of 19 colors gel eye pencils.  Each pencil ends up costing less than two dollars as opposed to  twenty for department store brands

Do not hesitate to buy this eyeliner set. I hesitated at first. They do glide on like butter. Just use a sharp tipped knife to break the seals on the packaging and it comes off easily. They really do not run at all from tears. They work like a $39 each type of eyeliner. Highly recommend.

reviews.t: If you like UD, but not the price...
reviews.x: Very pigmented and smooth. They glide similarly to Urban Decay 24/7 pencils, but have more staying power for me.  I only wish there was a broader selection of brights, like a shimmery pink or lavender, or even an orangey red. A lot of the colors are dark enough to be mistaken for black and would probably only be discernable in daylight or while being compared to black.  Overall, a great value for 19 full size liner pencils.

reviews.t: This is such a great deal! I fell in love with this eyeliner ...
reviews.x: This is such a great deal! I fell in love with this eyeliner 2 years ago. It goes on so easily and stays on all day. I have spent way more $$$ on the department store brands and never had it go on as nicely or last as long as this one does. It's the only brand of eyeliner that I use now.
Love the way the pencil glided across my lids. The colors are great.
Best eye liner I have ever tried. Goes on so smooth and effortlessly. Bright colors very pigmented. Love love love will definitely continue to buy

I wasn't too fond of the price but ladies these are amazing! Not a fan of a few colors but they are so easy to use and pigmented. They glide on easily and sharpen well. I love the variety and how they look with different looks. They work with fake lashes and don't ruin the lashes. I will for sure order more in the future!

These work really well, but you need a fine touch to apply, unless you want a really heavy line.  The only complaint I have is the way they're wrapped.  It's really hard trying to get the plastic off.  I don't feel there the need to wrap the entire pen in a hard to remove plastic.

reviews.t: Goes on easy, no dragging, colors are great and the orice is right!
reviews.x: I like this eyeliner because it glides on smoothly. Seems to stay on to. I use it for inner eye lid and it stays on! I bought the big pack, definitely worth it, lots of colors. I love the different blues and the teal is pretty! Try them you will like them to.

These eyeliners glide on easily.  I work a 12 hour shift, and these liners last the entire day even through the sweat and foggy safety glass.  Fantastic value and probably the best liners I've ever tried.  Colors are vibrant as well.

reviews.t: ... touch or it goes on thick but it glides nicely. Doesn't do very well with my under eyes ...
reviews.x: Have to use a very light touch or it goes on thick but it glides nicely.  Doesn't do very well with my under eyes as they are to moist.  I love the colors.

I honestly wanted just the champagne one out of this pack but I wasn't going to pay $6 for just the champagne when this was such a great deal.  I wasn't going to use these at all but I tried some out the other day and they all look great and they came just like in the picture.  Some colors are not my style so I might give them away but the rest I'm keeping to myself!

reviews.t: These babies didn’t come to play.
reviews.x: Sooo...for around $2 a pencil, I wasn’t expecting anything great. Still the reviews were good so I gave them a shot. I have gel eyeliners from Glossier that were $15 each and some from Colourpop that were $6 each. These are 100% just as good as both. I was extremely surprised. I’m so happy I came across these. The quality and price are on point.

I want to say that I was hesitant to get them as I normally do not use gel eyeliners, but I am glad I did!!! I have been using them almost every day and a lot of my friends are asking what eyeliner I use because it makes my eyes look like marbles.  I have gray eyes and the eyeliners make my color brighter.

reviews.t: Good value - Pigmented but Very Soft
reviews.x: It sucked unwrapping all of these individually, but they are a good value. The colors are pigmented and it goes on smooth-even on mature eyelids. The formula is very, very soft so while it goes on smooth, the pencil gets used up quickly and it smudges a bit on the eyes.

I like the product.  It goes on nicely.  May purchase again.  The only thing is that some of the pencils I cannot read the color that well and getting ready in the morning rush to work, I have to be quick and cannot go through trying on and taking off.

My eyes are so sensitive and I have trouble with anything in my waterline, but these are amazing. They don't irritate my eyes, the color glides right on (usually my eyes are so watery, nothing sticks) and the color stays all day.
Tenía miedo de perder mi dinero pero fue la mejor decisión! Puedo decir que es el mejor set de lápiz que he comprado vía Amazon
Wish I could give it 10 stars. Love these pencils. Highly pigmented and long lasting.

reviews.t: Great colors for brown skin tones.
reviews.x: Glides on easlily. Nice color and stays on. Colors look great on brown skin tones.
They are the best!! They don't smear at all!! The colors are great!!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the smooth, creamy glide and easy application of these eyeliners.
Many reviewers highlight the vivid, highly pigmented colors and the wide variety in the set.
Reviewers commonly note strong staying power and long wear, often comparing them favorably to pricier brands.
Several reviewers mention the packaging's shrink wrap is difficult to remove.
A few reviewers wish for a broader selection of bright colors, noting many shades are dark.
